termio CLI and termiod session server (macOS and Linux)

claims.answer: Native macOS app (macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel), an iOS companion on public TestFlight, and a termio CLI plus termiod server for macOS and Linux hosts; no Windows, Linux desktop, Android, web or editor extension yet (all roadmap).

desktop_os.answer: The only desktop client is the macOS 14+ app; Linux gets only termiod and the CLI as a server and Windows is listed as a roadmap item.

mobile_apps.answer: iOS companion beta via a public TestFlight link, paired by QR code; Android is "soon" on the roadmap.

browser.answer: Web support is a roadmap item; no browser client exists in the pinned source.

mobile_browser.answer: No web client, so no mobile browser access.

cli.answer: termio CLI (open, session list/watch/spawn/run/send/read/close/focus/create/attach, server deploy) on macOS and Linux.

task_actions.answer: Start sessions and agents, steer by typing, answer prompts with session send, read the unified diff and files; approvals are answered inside each agent terminal; commit, push and PR stay in the terminal; resume works where the agent supports it.

notifications.answer: Needs-you status dots, a menu-bar tray that rings when a session is blocked, termio notify macOS notifications, and the same signal on the iPhone.

cross_device_continuity.answer: termiod holds sessions, so the Mac, a CLI over SSH and the iPhone attach to the same session with the screen repainted from server scrollback.

limitations: macOS desktop only; Windows, Linux GUI, Android and web are roadmap.

claims.answer: Hosts 16 built-in agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, omp, Amp, Droid, Cursor, Copilot, Kimi, Qwen Code, Antigravity, Crush, Cline, Hermes, Grok) and any CLI through a custom manifest; it runs the CLIs in PTYs and reads their hooks, titles and transcripts rather than embedding a harness.

limitations: model providers: Model choice belongs to each CLI; Termio does not route model traffic.

operations.answer: Create (spawn, run, create), inspect (list, read, watch), steer (send), stop (close) and focus; review is the diff pane.

evidence.title: Termio README
evidence.locator: What it is; A tmux alternative; Remote ADE; Install; Drive it from the terminal; On your iPhone; Architecture; Roadmap
evidence.finding: Native macOS terminal-first ADE hosting Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Cursor, Copilot and others; termiod daemon keeps sessions alive; Linux VPS setup over SSH; termio CLI lets an agent spawn siblings; iPhone companion on TestFlight; Android, Windows, web, TUI and issue triage are roadmap items; MIT.

evidence.title: termio Package.swift
evidence.finding: Swift 6 package for macOS 14+ using libghostty, Sparkle auto-update and swift-markdown; Highlightr vendored.

evidence.title: termio LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT License for the repository.

evidence.title: termio termiod/Cargo.toml
evidence.finding: termiod 0.1.0 Rust session host, MIT, described as a durable PTY session host where detach is not kill.

evidence.title: termiod architecture
evidence.finding: Why every session lives in termiod and clients only attach; one protocol over unix socket, SSH pipe or WSS.

evidence.title: Termio docs: concepts
evidence.locator: Device; Workspace; Project; Session; Pane; Worktree
evidence.finding: Device, workspace, project, session, pane and worktree model; sessions run inside termiod on their machine and are addressable by termio://session/<uuid> links.

evidence.title: Termio docs: agents
evidence.locator: Built-in agents; What each agent reports
evidence.finding: Built-in agents: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, omp, Amp, Droid, Cursor, Copilot, Kimi, Qwen Code, Antigravity, Crush, Cline, Hermes, Grok; status via program status protocol, hooks, title, progress or pane activity.

evidence.title: Termio docs: custom-agents
evidence.finding: Any CLI can become a first-class agent through a manifest.

evidence.title: Termio docs: atp
evidence.finding: Agent manifests declare status channels and conversation resume behavior per agent.

evidence.title: Termio docs: session-control
evidence.finding: Opt-in status hooks and a termio agent skill (installed into ~/.claude/skills and ~/.codex/skills) let agents report status and drive sibling sessions; files stay on the Mac.

evidence.title: Termio docs: cli
evidence.locator: The orchestration model; Drive sessions; Spawning without waiting
evidence.finding: termio session list/watch/spawn/run/send/read/close/focus/create/attach with --json, --wait, --agent and pane placement; project-scoped; results read from transcripts; signal never kill.

evidence.title: Termio docs: persistence
evidence.finding: Sessions outlive the app, window, SSH link and self-updates; they end on Close Session, server stop or reboot; layout restored and Mac agents resume when supported.

evidence.title: Termio docs: devices
evidence.locator: Adding a machine; Setting up a machine
evidence.finding: Machines are anything reachable over ssh; Set Up copies termiod and the CLI into ~/.local/bin without root and installs hooks and skills; no Termio cloud.

evidence.title: Termio docs: remote-hosts
evidence.finding: Remote hosts read from ~/.ssh/config; password saved in Keychain; Settings Remote Hosts manages setup and publish.

evidence.title: Termio docs: server
evidence.locator: What it is; Getting it onto a machine; Keeping it running
evidence.finding: termiod install on a Linux box by curl script (x86_64 or aarch64, systemd --user, built-in Tailscale, pairing link), or from a Mac over SSH; server handoff updates in place.

evidence.title: Termio docs: iphone
evidence.locator: Pairing; What you can do from the phone; Reaching a machine remotely
evidence.finding: iOS app pairs by QR code with machines you own, mirrors sessions with live status, types into the real terminal, previews files; Tailscale or tunnels; no relay of Termio.

evidence.title: Termio docs: installation
evidence.locator: What you need; Staying up to date
evidence.finding: Requires macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel); no account, license key or payment backend; Sparkle update checks send only IP and version; Homebrew cask available.

evidence.title: Termio docs: worktrees
evidence.locator: How Termio sees worktrees; Reviewing the work
evidence.finding: Worktrees come from git worktree list and appear nested under projects; the git pane is read-only (Changes, Compare, History); commit, push and PR stay in the terminal.

evidence.title: Termio docs: inspector
evidence.finding: Inspector with file tree and editor, read-only unified diff, Compare and History tabs, and git grep search, on this Mac or on the machine the session runs on.

evidence.title: Termio docs: sidebar
evidence.finding: Sidebar rows report working, idle, done or needs you; Chats are scratch agent sessions outside any project.

evidence.title: Termio docs: workspaces
evidence.finding: Named workspaces each belong to exactly one machine and remember the session left on.

evidence.title: Termio docs: appearance
evidence.finding: General tab includes the GitHub integration behind the inspector Issues pane and a Privacy switch for anonymous daily usage statistics.

evidence.title: Termio docs: troubleshooting
evidence.finding: Troubleshooting guide pointing to GitHub issues for bugs.

evidence.title: termio Sources/termio/App/Analytics.swift
evidence.finding: Anonymous once-per-day active-install count (random install UUID, app and macOS version, language) to PostHog; off in dev, under swift run and when disabled in Settings General Privacy; the projectAPIKey constant is empty in source so a fork sends nothing.

evidence.title: termio Sources/termio/Settings/Settings.swift
evidence.finding: analyticsEnabled stored under privacy.analyticsEnabled with default true.

evidence.title: Mac retention analytics design

evidence.finding: Inspector Issues pane lists the bound GitHub repo issues and pull requests with filter and detail view; GitHub provider only in the pinned source.

evidence.title: termio Sources/termio/Issues/GitHubIssueAuth.swift
evidence.finding: GitHub authentication for the Issues pane (credentials kept in Keychain per design).

evidence.title: Issue tracker integration design
evidence.finding: Design: issue and PR list with send-to-agent; first version excludes notifications, creating or closing issues, Jira, PR review and merge.

evidence.title: Scheduled runs design (draft)

evidence.finding: Shared live session links exist only as a draft design.

evidence.finding: termiod can keep the host awake while sessions run.

evidence.title: termio Shared/Sources/TermioShared

evidence.title: termio scripts/termio
evidence.finding: Shell entry for the termio CLI in the repository scripts.

evidence.finding: Homebrew cask termio-sh/tap/termio installs the app.

evidence.finding: MIT fork of Swift bindings for the Ghostty terminal core used by the Mac and iOS apps.

evidence.finding: Release v0.74.0 published 2026-11-15 at commit 3b861e5.

evidence.title: web/landing/content/docs/persistence.mdx
evidence.finding: Termio keeps no durable transcript: scrollback lives in the server for the session lifetime and goes away with it, except a handoff replay buffer held in a temp file that is unlinked; agent conversations stay in each agent's own store.

evidence.title: web/landing/content/docs/cli.mdx
evidence.finding: Readiness is judged from the screen; list --json flags prompt_undelivered and the caller is told to check it and send the prompt again with send, so a repeated send is an explicit manual step.

evidence.title: web/landing/content/docs/cli.mdx
evidence.finding: No locking, ordering or concurrent-send behavior is documented for session send; the only hits concern worktrees keeping agents apart and a queued payload flag on spawn.

evidence.title: web/landing/content/docs/server.mdx
evidence.finding: No session-count limit, concurrency figure or host sizing guidance is documented in the CLI, server, persistence or concepts pages.

evidence.title: web/landing/content/docs/agents.mdx
evidence.finding: No provider-terms or subscription-restriction guidance for hosted agent CLIs appears in the agents page or README.
